item.title: IHL funding package poses major capital dollars for MSU, MUW
item.description: Mississippi State University and Mississippi University for Women could see significant funding increases for capital projects and programs under a Senate-approved higher education package now awaiting House action. item.title: Area school districts see graduation gains, dropout declines
item.description: Most districts around the Golden Triangle saw improvements in their four-year graduation rates and dropout rates during the 2024-2025 school year compared to five years prior. The post Area school districts see graduation gains, dropout declines appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Rebels lose double-OT heartbreaker, drop 10th straight game
item.description: LSU’s Max Mackinnon scored a game-high 34 points against Ole Miss on Wednesday night, helping the Tigers overcome an eight-point deficit with 7:04 left in the second half to send the game to overtime and eventually emerge with a 106-99 win in double overtime at SJB Pavilion. It is the 10th loss in a row for Ole Miss (11-17, 3-12 SEC). The post Rebels lose double-OT heartbreaker, drop 10th straight game appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: No. 12 MSU gets road win over Georgia Tech in Tiger Invitational tuneup
item.description: Mississippi State softball improved to 15-1 on the season with another road victory and another impressive performance at the plate. The Bulldogs stopped in Atlanta for a true road game at Georgia Tech on Wednesday, adding a midweek test on the way to Clemson, S.C., for the Tiger Invitational. They were able to set the pace offensively in a back-and-forth contest before taking control in the final inning of an 8-3 victory. The post No. 12 MSU gets road win over Georgia Tech in Tiger Invitational

item.title: Our View: Level 3 trauma designation in Oktibbeha signals a promise kept
item.description: One of the reasons some counties have been reluctant to sell their county-owned hospital is that citizens lose whatever leverage they had as owners. Once the hospital changes hands, all the decision-making power lies in the hands of the new owners who are free to do with the hospital as they wish. The post Our View: Level 3 trauma designation in Oktibbeha signals a promise kept appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: NCAA rules panel proposes letting player ejected for targeting in 2nd half to play entire next game
item.description: Division I football rules makers have proposed a one-year trial rule allowing a player disqualified for targeting for the first time to play in his team’s next game regardless of which half the penalty was assessed, the NCAA announced Thursday. The post NCAA rules panel proposes letting player ejected for targeting in 2nd half to play entire next game appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.description: The Lowndes County School District is to be well represented in the MHSAA Class 5A state powerlifting meet as both Caledonia and New Hope earned podium finishes Wednesday in the North Half meet and both teams left with some hardware.
